description: Defines the Patient class with attributes, a factory constructor to create an instance from a Map, and a method to convert the instance back to a Map. It represents a model for patient data within a healthcare Flutter app.

classes.name: Patient
classes.description: A data model representing a patient, including personal details, contact information, and a profile image URL.

methods.name: Patient.fromMap
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates a Patient instance from a Map, parsing and converting values as necessary.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Converts a Patient instance into a Map<String, dynamic> suitable for serialization or storage.
